connector.name: Mythic Index
connector.registryDescription: MTG card prices, deck analysis, and investment intelligence - 19 tools over the Mythic Index API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mythic-index-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wizkid17 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MYTHIC_INDEX_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the Mythic Index API. Defaults to the bundled public read-only key.

env.name: MYTHIC_INDEX_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Mythic Index API. Defaults to https://api.mythic-index.com.
